rationale: C17 plausibly supplied the child's core appointment-letter formula: an opening expressing delight that the recipient agreed to serve, immediate identification of the appointed presidential role, and an explanation of the nationally important work the appointee would perform. C25 and C11 also share committee-appointment and contribution language, but their openings and overall formulations are less closely aligned with the child.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am delighted to learn that you have agreed to serve as a member of the Committee on Education Beyond the High School
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am delighted that you have agreed to serve as Special Assistant to the President for aviation facilities planning.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctively close opening appointment formula, with the same expression of delight, agreement to serve, and identification of the presidential assignment.

shared_material.child_excerpt: you can through the work of this Committee perform a great service to the Nation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In this capacity you will be responsible for: 1. The direction and coordination of a long-range study of the Nation's requirements for aviation facilities.
shared_material.explanation: Both letters follow the appointment with an explanation of the appointee's nationally significant planning work, though the child's version is much shorter.
